item.title: No longer Detroit Mayor, Duggan campaigning for governor full time
item.description: With Mary Sheffield in office, Detroit’s former mayor Mike Duggan has become a full-time candidate for governor of Michigan. Duggan held a Zoom roundtable on Tuesday to discuss his campaign to replace the term-limited Governor Gretchen Whitmer.
